documents.title: Bastrop County FY2025-26 Adopted Budget Report
documents.note: Adopted by Commissioners Court Aug 25, 2025. General Fund $73,512,281; Road & Bridge $13,704,096; Debt Service $6,522,538; tax rate $0.42870/$100.

Bastrop County 2025 Tax Rate Notice (Form 50-212)
documents.note: Adopted rate $0.42870; no-new-revenue $0.40151; total debt levy $5,890,509.

documents.note: Certified taxable value $13,474,499,007; M&O rate $0.38499 + debt (I&S) $0.04371 = $0.42870; voter-approval rate $0.42870 (adopted at the maximum without an election).

documents.title: Bastrop CAD — Bastrop County Tax Rates 2019-2025
documents.note: Adopted county rate splits by fund: General Fund $0.350500 + Road $0.078210 = $0.428710. City of Bastrop 2025 rate $0.504000.

documents.title: Bastrop County Debt Service Booklet (as of Oct 1, 2025, prepared by PFM)
documents.note: Outstanding principal $70,025,000; total remaining principal + interest $96,508,940; final maturity 8/1/2044; FY2025-26 payment $6,517,537. The 2024 certificate of obligation ($31.325M) is ~42% of all principal. Ratings AA+ (S&P), Aa1 (Moody's).

documents.title: Bastrop County Annual Comprehensive Financial Report, FY ended Sept 30, 2024
documents.note: Independent auditor Pattillo, Brown & Hill, L.L.P.; unmodified (clean) opinion; total net position of governmental activities $69,009,465. A federal Single Audit was required for FY2024, but its findings schedule is a separate report not published online — that piece is still a dead end.

documents.title: Bastrop County AP Check Report (open check register)
documents.note: The county publishes an itemized check register — every vendor, date, check number, account code, and amount — more disclosure than most Texas counties. Largest named payees in the Dec 2024-Jan 2025 report include ATMAX Equipment ($596,924, road equipment), Lake Country Chevrolet ($544,029, fleet), Pavecon ($354,391, paving), and Halff Associates ($175,769, engineering).
